_README: THE MENU. Copy this file to static/cadabra-script.json to turn Mr. Cadabra ON.
Delete that copy to turn him off. There is no other switch, and no page changes.
Adding a NEW behaviour is code (see BEHAVIOURS in cadabra.js).
Scheduling one is editing this file. Rules are in PRESENCE_RULES.md.
_CHANGE_NOTES: Keep newest at top. JSON has no comments, so the notes live here.
